_meta.description: Gary Chapman's 5 Love Languages — full profiles, quiz, and cross-type communication guide

tagline.en: Actions don't always speak louder than words
tagline.ko: 행동이 항상 말보다 강한 것은 아니다

description.en: This person feels loved when they receive verbal compliments, encouragement, and appreciation. Harsh words cut deeply and are remembered long after.
description.ko: 이 유형의 사람은 언어적 칭찬, 격려, 감사를 받을 때 사랑받는다고 느낍니다. 거친 말은 깊이 상처를 주고 오래 기억됩니다.

en: given specific compliments ('You're so talented at...')
say what you appreciate about them before bed
text encouragement before a big event

description.en: This person feels loved when their partner lightens their load through helpful actions. Laziness or broken promises feel like rejection.
description.ko: 이 유형의 사람은 파트너가 도움이 되는 행동으로 부담을 덜어줄 때 사랑받는다고 느낍니다. 게으름이나 깨진 약속은 거부처럼 느껴집니다.

en: partner shows up in difficult moments practically
partner makes more work for them
they must ask repeatedly for help
partner is physically present but unhelpful
ko: 파트너가 물리적으로 있지만 도움이 안 될 때

en: notice what stresses them and help preemptively
research solutions to a problem they're facing
organize something that's been bothering them

tagline.en: Don't mistake this love language for materialism
tagline.ko: 이 사랑의 언어를 물질주의로 오해하지 마세요

description.en: This person feels loved through thoughtful gifts that symbolize care and attention. It's not about monetary value — a found pebble can mean as much as jewelry.
description.ko: 이 유형의 사람은 관심과 배려를 상징하는 사려 깊은 선물을 통해 사랑받는다고 느낍니다. 금전적 가치가 아니라 사려깊음이 중요합니다.

en: surprised with something they mentioned once
given a symbol of a shared memory
ko: 사려 깊고 개인화된 선물을 받을 때
한 번 언급했던 것으로 놀라게 해줄 때

en: note what they admire or need
give gifts on regular days, not just occasions
create a photo album of memories
find something from a place you visited together

tagline.en: Full, undivided attention is the gift

description.en: This person feels loved when their partner gives them complete, focused attention. Distractions, postponed plans, and being on the phone feel like rejection.
description.ko: 이 유형의 사람은 파트너가 완전하고 집중된 관심을 줄 때 사랑받는다고 느낍니다. 주의 산만, 미뤄진 계획, 전화 사용이 거부처럼 느껴집니다.

en: phone is put away on dates
time together is rushed or half-hearted
ko: 함께하는 시간이 급하거나 열의가 없을 때

en: watch their favorite movie with full attention

tagline.en: Physical presence and connection are key communicators of love
tagline.ko: 물리적 존재와 연결이 사랑의 핵심 전달자이다

description.en: This person feels loved through physical connection — hugs, holding hands, a hand on the shoulder. Physical neglect or coldness feels like emotional abandonment.
description.ko: 이 유형의 사람은 포옹, 손 잡기, 어깨에 손 얹기 등의 물리적 연결을 통해 사랑받는다고 느낍니다. 신체적 소홀이나 냉담함은 감정적 포기처럼 느껴집니다.

en: a hand on the shoulder during stress
hugs or kisses are withheld during conflict
no physical greeting after time apart
ko: 갈등 중 포옹이나 키스를 거부할 때
떨어져 있다가 만날 때 물리적 인사 없음
파트너가 스킨십을 피하는 것 같을 때

en: offer a back rub after a hard day
long hug when they come home
sit close to them when watching something

question.en: What would feel most meaningful from your partner today?
question.ko: 오늘 파트너에게서 가장 의미 있게 느껴질 것은 무엇인가요?

text.en: A heartfelt compliment or 'I love you'
They surprise you by doing something you've been putting off
An hour of phone-free, focused time together
text.ko: 전화 없이 집중하여 함께하는 한 시간

text.en: A long hug and holding hands

question.en: When you feel disconnected from your partner, you most want them to:
question.ko: 파트너와 멀어진 느낌이 들 때, 가장 원하는 것은:

text.en: Tell you how much they appreciate and value you
Do something helpful without you having to ask
text.ko: 부탁하지 않아도 도움이 되는 일을 해주기

text.en: Bring you a small gift to show they're thinking of you
text.ko: 당신을 생각한다는 것을 보여주는 작은 선물

text.en: Set aside uninterrupted time just to be with you
text.ko: 방해받지 않고 당신과 함께하는 시간 마련하기

text.en: Give you a warm, long hug

question.en: What hurts most when your partner does it?
question.ko: 파트너가 하는 것 중 가장 상처가 되는 것은?

text.en: Forgetting your birthday or important occasions
Being distracted when you're trying to talk
Being cold or withholding physical affection

words_to_acts.en: Instead of just saying 'I'll help', actually do the task

acts_to_words.en: Add verbal acknowledgment to your helpful actions
acts_to_words.ko: 도움이 되는 행동에 언어적 인정 더하기

gifts_to_time.en: Instead of a gift, plan a meaningful experience together
gifts_to_time.ko: 선물 대신 의미 있는 경험 함께 계획하기

time_to_touch.en: Add physical affection during your quality time

touch_to_words.en: Pair physical affection with verbal affirmation
